thread:
maya: quick follow-up on unified-loader idea. goal: single loader that handles transports + formats, provides a bounded sync hotpath to start inference, then hydrates remaining tensors async.
sam: agree but sync hotpath must be strictly bounded (e.g. <200ms). it should only return seed blobs + handle. anything else async.
noor: proposed minimal ABI:
LoadSync(model_ref, seed_policy) -> {handle, fast_meta, seed_blobs}
Hydrate(handle, policy) -> returns immediately, emits progress events
seed_policy default = [embeddings, first_block] and policy has credit_budget, quant_target.
vincent: credit_budget must be per-instance. runtime should expose pressure signal so loader can reduce prefetch or pick pre-quantized artifacts.
maya: ops concerns: if chunk download fails mid-hydration, emit telemetry, try alternates, keep serving if non-critical, fail-fast if critical. ops-bot: noted runbook required.
ops-bot: runbook sketch: mark instance degraded, route to fallback variant, schedule integrity check, alert only on repeated failures >5m.
sam: support dedup_key for shared blobs (content-hash + namespace) so sidecar can cache and reduce warmup traffic.
noor: manifest-v2 should include chunk ids -> CA blob ids + prefer_local hint. loader exposes ResolveChunk(chunk_id) -> uris. small LRU cache for resolves.
vincent: testing: unit test for LoadSync bounds, fake-transport that aborts mid-stream, e2e cold-start perf (sync path) and background-hydration cost accounting.
maya: migration: land behind feature-flag, canary for internal traffic then small % hosted. fallback if LoadSync > X ms or Hydrate error rate high. I'll write a short RFC addendum and list action items.
